status: Structure only. The eight-section downsell sequence is the one in references/page-structures.json roles.downsell_1 (derived from Skill 81's downsell-page schema); this file registers it as a copy form so scripts/copy_forms.py gives the downsell page a form of its own and Skill 71's form guards (shared_page_service.py, the request builder, the section-count check) stop treating it as a Standard landing page. Skill 81's validators stay the authority on the copy itself, and references/page-structures.json stays the authority on each section's layout and image slots; tests/test_copy_forms_cover_all_roles.py fails if the two sequences, names or jobs drift apart. It names its role with the plural page_roles (like the upsell form), so a request that has lost its page_role marker is still refused as a landing page instead of recovering the role from a copy_version.

sections.job: make the alternative clear immediately, and state in the first screen that the original order is confirmed and safe
a specific pain or objection this alternative answers, distinct from the next two
a second, different pain or objection
a third, different pain or objection
the real reason this alternative exists
who the alternative fits, without shaming anyone who declines
the exact inclusions and the material limitations, shown with equal honesty
exactly seven optional benefits the visitor will not receive by declining; never a loss of the original purchase

cta_map.note: A primary button in every section, each with the outlined decline button beside it (references/page-structures.json roles.downsell_1.decline).

containment.no_extras_rule: A section id outside 1 to 8, a duplicate, or a lettered child id fails.
